primary_endpoint: Least-squares mean change from baseline at Week 16 in LDL concentration, LDL particle size, and total LDL particle concentration.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 16, LDL concentration changes were −33.2, −44.27, and −39.54 mg/dL with 5, 10, and 25 mg OCA, respectively, versus −53.33 mg/dL with placebo. LDL particle size changes were 0.02, −0.41, and −0.09 nm versus −0.49 nm; total LDL particle concentration changes were −224.79, −325.04, and −336.22 nmol/L versus −439.84 nmol/L. No statistical comparisons were reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: 2/20 with 5 mg OCA, 1/21 with 10 mg, 1/22 with 25 mg, and 0/21 with placebo; no deaths.
